name: DevCycle Free
free_limit: 1,000 client-side MAUs; 10,000 cloud config requests/month; 100,000 server config requests/month; 5,000 events/month; unlimited feature flags and seats
watch_out: Client-side MAUs count unique client SDK initializations, while cloud-bucketing requests, server SDK configuration fetches and events have separate quotas. Free has no credit card requirement. Paid Business features and overages are separate; the pricing page does not clearly specify Free over-quota behavior, so do not assume unlimited calls or automatic billing.
